Looking at this question, I need to identify which neurotransmitter transporter shows reduced engulfment by microglia in neonatal male mice injected with NIF (a glycoprotein from the canine hookworm *Ancylostoma caninum*).

NIF is known to modulate immune responses, and in neonatal models, it affects microglial function during critical periods of brain development. Microglia are key players in synaptic pruning and phagocytosis of presynaptic elements during development.

The vesicular glutamate transporters (VGlut1, VGlut2, VGlut3) mark excitatory presynaptic terminals, while GATs (GAT1, GAT2, GAT3) are GABA transporters. In studies of microglial phagocytic engulfment of synaptic elements in neonatal brain development, VGlut2 is the most commonly referenced and abundant vesicular glutamate transporter marker for excitatory presynaptic terminals that are targeted for microglial phagocytosis.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
